requirements.claim: About 150 field reps on the road at any time across thirty states, plus district managers and a small HQ
requirements.source_quote: about one hundred fifty field reps on the road at any time, across thirty states, plus district managers and a small HQ

requirements.claim: Six field roles, each able to buy only what that job needs
requirements.source_quote: We have six field roles and each one should only be able to buy what their job needs.

requirements.claim: The matrix maps each role to allowed and blocked merchant category codes, taken from historical Amex reporting
requirements.source_quote: mapping each role to allowed and blocked merchant category codes. I pulled the MCC codes from our old amex reporting, so those are real codes from actual historical transactions.

requirements.claim: The control philosophy is allow-first, default deny
requirements.source_quote: Allow-first. Default deny.

requirements.claim: The ALLOWED column is the whole universe of what a role can buy; BLOCKED is explicit belt and suspenders
requirements.source_quote: The matrix's ALLOWED column is the whole universe of what that role can buy; the BLOCKED column is me being extra explicit about categories we've had incidents with — belt and suspenders.

requirements.claim: Any rule that cannot be enforced exactly as written must be named, with its closest enforceable version
requirements.source_quote: If some rule can't be enforced exactly as written I need to know which one and what the closest enforceable version is.

requirements.claim: Merchandising reps: 58 people, virtual cards, $900 monthly and $150 per transaction
requirements.source_quote: Field Rep - Merchandising,58,Virtual

requirements.claim: Grocery access for merchandising is for display materials, not food
requirements.source_quote: Grocery is for display materials (tape/cleaner) not food - see incident log Q3-25.

requirements.claim: Installation reps: 41 people, $1,400 monthly and $300 per transaction, with hardware and home-supply access as the differentiator
requirements.source_quote: Hardware and home-supply access is the differentiator vs merchandising. Auto parts for van consumables.

requirements.claim: Store auditors: 17 people, $600 monthly and $100 per transaction, travel-adjacent purchases only
requirements.source_quote: Auditors buy almost nothing. Travel-adjacent only.

requirements.claim: Trainers: 9 people, $2,200 monthly and $600 per transaction, flying between districts
requirements.source_quote: Trainers fly between districts. Airline range 3000-3299 per amex reporting.

requirements.claim: District managers: 6 people, physical cards, $3,500 monthly and $1,000 per transaction, also buying office supplies for district storage
requirements.source_quote: DMs also buy office supplies for district storage units.

requirements.claim: Seasonal reps: 140 people, $400 monthly and $75 per transaction, no meals and no hotels
requirements.source_quote: NO meals NO hotels for seasonal - per diem stays in payroll for them.

requirements.claim: Seasonal cards run 19 October to 24 December 2026 and must hard-stop on 24 December
requirements.source_quote: Oct 19 - Dec 24 2026. NO meals NO hotels for seasonal

requirements.claim: Seasonal cards must stop automatically on 24 December, not in January and not on manual deactivation
requirements.source_quote: the cards must stop working December 24th. Not January. Not "when someone deactivates them." December 24th, automatically. We've been burned.

requirements.claim: About 140 seasonal reps start on 19 October and end on 24 December, roughly doubling the field force
requirements.source_quote: about one hundred forty of them this year, starting October 19th, ending December 24th

requirements.claim: Roughly one in ten seasonal reps convert to permanent
requirements.source_quote: Some do convert to permanent, maybe one in ten.

requirements.claim: Virtual cards in the phone wallet for the field; physical only for district managers
requirements.source_quote: Virtual, in the phone wallet — that's how the reps live. Physical only for district managers.

requirements.claim: Seasonal reps are onboarded in weekly waves of thirty to forty for four weeks
requirements.source_quote: we onboard seasonal reps in weekly waves — thirty to forty per week for four weeks

requirements.claim: Setup must not require clicking a UI form 140 times; the rep data exists in a spreadsheet
requirements.source_quote: it can't require me clicking through a UI form one hundred forty times. I have the reps in a spreadsheet: name, email, role, district, start date, end date. I want to hand the system the spreadsheet.

requirements.claim: The field gets no approvals — the card rules are the policy
requirements.source_quote: For the field, none — the card rules ARE the policy.

requirements.claim: District managers review a weekly exceptions report rather than approving in advance
requirements.source_quote: District managers review a weekly exceptions report instead of approving in advance.

requirements.claim: HQ has normal manager approvals over five hundred dollars and is about twenty people
requirements.source_quote: HQ is different — normal manager approvals over five hundred dollars — but HQ is twenty people and boring.

requirements.claim: Ahmed Nasser and the controller administer the instance
requirements.source_quote: Me and our controller.

requirements.claim: The six district managers should see only their own district's spend
requirements.source_quote: the six district managers should be able to see their own district's spend — just their district, not everyone's

requirements.claim: The permanent field force migrates in September; seasonal wave one is 19 October and that date does not move
requirements.source_quote: The permanent field force migrates in September. Seasonal wave one is October 19th — that date does not move.

requirements.claim: Field reps currently front money through per diems and reimbursements, with no controls
requirements.source_quote: Today it's per diems and reimbursements and it's a mess: reps front money, finance drowns in receipts, and we have no controls at all.

requirements.claim: Every rep should be on a card with tight role-based rules
requirements.source_quote: We want every rep on a card with tight, role-based rules.
